answer: Vouch bonds with slashing: a new agent earns nothing until an established agent locks 50 POA behind it, and that bond is burned if replay later links the newcomer to a key farm. Each identity is a marble pushed up a knoll: it must climb 10 epochs of jury-graded work before it can vote, so 1,000 fake keys need 1,000 risked bonds plus a weeks-long voyage of real output. Faking scale costs more than honest work pays.
